title: Especialista De Modelagem Hidráulica Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Contribuir em grupos de trabalho e iniciativas de evolução técnica da área.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Sanitária, Ambiental ou correlatas.
  • Experiência prática em modelagem hidráulica (construção, calibração, setorização, cenários e ampliação).

  • Experiência com projetos de saneamento.

Diferenciais

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.


Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);
    Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Tech Lead - .Net E Angular
description:
Modelo de trabalho: híbrido 2x por semana no escritório

Localização: Escritório Central I Rio de Janeiro

Regime de contratação: CLT + benefícios



Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (.NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.

Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).

Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.


Principais responsabilidades:

Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias, realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy, gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).


Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

BASIC FUNCTION : Position has primary responsibility for the operational procedure and process associated with contractual arrangements/agreements for goods and services procured by the University. Also responsible for preaward and/or postaward functions for a variety of supply, service, and/or construction contracts for several activities within an organizational component or in a geographical area. The employee is responsible for a variety of contracts which frequently require special handling provisions or other specialized terms and conditions. Some contracts cover a period of more than one year. Typical requirements include technical equipment, supplies, construction, and services ranging from standard items which are complicated by urgent delivery requirements or security classification to complex or sophisticated requirements. Examples include equipment or services needed to support a research and development activity;
ADP equipment, softwareand related services;
conversion of installation functions from in-house to contract operations;
negotiated contracts with disadvantaged business firms;
contracts for PrincipalInvestigators and other specialized services and equipment for Research or a Hospital;
construction projects related to new buildings, roads, docks, and others which consist of standard design and specifications;
negotiation of contractmodifications and change orders caused by inadequate existing drawings, defective specifications, or changed site conditions;
alteration and repair projects such as those requiring the demolition and removal of existing walls and windows, relocation of heating and air conditioning systems, and modification of primary lighting and communication channels;
contracts for design and/or engineering services, other technical services, and technical equipment and supplies;
or contracts for acquisition and installation of building equipment systems.

SUPERVISORY

AUTHORITY: None

NATURE AND SCOPE :

Internal contacts include the Office of the General Counsel, executives, administrators, managers, faculty, staff and students of the University departments, units and offices. External contacts include Federal, state, local and other governmental sponsors of research/training programs at Howard University, private foundations, vendors, auditors, inspectors and other representatives working on behalf of program sponsors, representatives from other universities, institutes and other organizations with whom Howard University works on sponsored research/training programs and industry trade organizations (such as the National Contract Management Association and the National Council of University Research Administrators and others)

PRINCIPAL

ACCOUNTABILITIES :

Prepares documentation and legal draft of contracts/agreements, ensuring contract/agreement requirements are met, and works directly with Compliance Office and Office of General Counsel (OGC) to ensure contract/agreement language and requirements are appropriate and complies with Howard University and Hospital policies and procedures, and federal and state laws, to resolve compliance issues

Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times, including patient & student, and proprietary information.

Coordinates work with various departments and serves as a liaison between HU and vendors to oversee the intake, review and finalization of all contracts that bind the University.

Maintain University Contracts and systems to ensure timely renegotiation and consistency of language/terms in order to provide maximum legal coverage.

Examines the operational scope of contracts, working collaboratively with user departments to ensure compliance.

Serves as a consultant and educator to management and administrative staff relating to contract/agreement compliance requirements and issues.

Review and analyze contracts not requiring legal review and identify language issues and/or concerns.

Provides guidance to technical personnel involved in the development of the statement of work or data requirements. Formulates the contracting approach to be taken that will best satisfy the requirement.

In formally advertised procurements, ensures that the bid schedule is properly structured, prepares the solicitation, determines sources to be solicited, conducts prebid conferences, processes protests, determines the responsiveness of bids and determines the responsibility of the apparent low bidder based on an analysis of financial and technical information gained during the preaward survey, and awards or recommends award of the contract.

In negotiated procurements, the employee plans the procurement action with technical, legal, and contract pricing personnel. Provides guidance in the development of the statement of work and data requirements, determines the type of contract best suited to the requirement, develops special clauses and terms and conditions applicable to the solicitation. Determines the sources to be solicited, prepares applicable determinations and findings, conducts preproposal conferences, receives and evaluates proposals in conjunction with price/cost analysts or other technical personnel, determines the competitive range in negotiations with one or more offerors, prepares award documents and makes presentation to a contract board of awards or source selection authority when appropriate. Responds to inquiries, including formal protests and congressional inquiries.

Monitors contractor performance in relation to the completion schedule required by the contract, insuring timely submission of technical progress reports, making periodic visits to the contractor's facility or work site, detecting and correcting labor standards violations, taking appropriate action to expedite delivery or performance when required by mission changes, monitoring the contractor's use of University-furnished property inventories, and issuing change orders occasioned by changes in mission requirements, defective specifications, changed site conditions, or changes in University-furnished property. Negotiates settlements for such changes, approves contract payments, assesses liquidated or actual damages for nonperformance, issues show cause or cure notices, terminates contracts for default or convenience and negotiates settlements, prepares replies to other involved agencies, appeal boards, or congressional inquiries.

Coordinates review of issues list with management staff. Negotiate all required language changes and review final documents to ensure all changes are appropriately made. Prepare correspondence necessary to accomplish the finalization of contracts being processed.

Create contract files, negotiate changes, coordinate full and final execution of all contract documents, maintain Master Contract Filing system, administration and maintenance of the Contract Management Database, to include;
monitoring, follow-up and resolution of all renewal notifications;
scan and add all finalized contracts, amendments and insurance certificates to the database.

Monitors Contracts Administration e-mail and responds to customer inquiries in a professional, courteous and prompt manner no later than one business day after receipt of inquiry.

Maintains the highest degree of confidentiality with respect to information relating to business transactions and HU employees, patients, guests, physicians, co-workers and vendors.

Assists in the preparation of training manuals and training documentation for on-going

contracts training, ensuring that manuals are updated appropriately with the newest

version of procedures.

Assists with training faculty, staff, and students on legal issues in grants and contracts administration.

Promotes adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training.

Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.

Actively participates in Health Sciences Compliance Program activities.

Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.

Maintains confidentiality of patients, families, faculty, students, and staff.

Performs other job related duties within the assigned timeframes assigned by Director.

CORE COMPETENCIES :

Sensitive to the interrelationship of both people and functions within the department.

Ability to apply strict confidentiality regarding budget issues.

Strong team building and interpersonal skills

Strong project and relationship management skills

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious working relations with staff, University officials and the general public

Good communication skills

Customer service orientation

Must be able to read and interpret the underlying purpose of contractual agreements, including the concepts of offer and acceptance and bargained-for transaction.

Knowledge of the healthcare industry and of University purchasing practices, procedures and techniques is also desirable.

Must be comfortable communicating instructions and process information to customers of all levels within the organization, including executive leaders.

Comprehensive knowledge of Government Contracting and related laws, regulations and guidelines such as FARS.

Comprehensive knowledge of the terminology related to the sponsored research agreements.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

Knowledge of computer skills: spreadsheet, database, word processing, and presentation software as well as other standard office equipment. Ability to use technology – contract management software and a standard suite of office software applications

Ability to organize information, generate reports and maintain data regarding contracts and contract process requests in a database.

Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

MINIMUM

REQUIREMENTS :

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field of study

5 to 10 years experience in an academic, healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Experience with Workday

Experienced with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFAR) a plus

Possession of a Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), a Certified Research Administrator, or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) certification is preferred.

This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment.

$70,000-$80,000

determines eligibility within the parameters of institutional, state and federal requirements.

May be responsible for the supervision of student employees in the financial aid office.

NATURE AND SCOPE:

Internal contacts include students, faculty and staff. External contacts include families, prospective students, student advocates, and representatives of government agencies, lending institutions, guarantee agencies, community organizations, legislative representatives, and the general public.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Exercises independent judgment in the management of operational details of the financial aid process including but not limited to:
  • Provide advising throughout the financial aid process to prospective, new and current students and their families.
  • Reviews incoming financial aid application and any supporting documentation needed to determine the accuracy of the financial and household information reported on the FAFSA. This requires knowledge of not only federal financial aid regulations but IRS tax laws and how they relate to federal financial aid.
  • Complete assigned duties with a high degree of accuracy to ensure compliance while experiencing multiple interruptions.
  • Exercise great attention to detail when completing assignments as error in judgment or calculations could result in unintended consequences for the student and/or the institution such as under or over funding of a student, loss of student eligibility, audit findings, fines, damage to school’s reputation or loss of institutional eligibility.
  • Will have the authority to recalculate and makes changes to financial aid awards when student’s eligibility changes.
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state and institutional policies as it relates to the awarding and disbursements of federal, state and institutional aid.
  • Assists with the oversight of the administration of both the federal and private loans. This includes the certification of private education loans, resolving issues between the university’s system and the Dept. of Educations. Participation in state, regional and national professional development activities to ensure a complete understanding of federal and state regulations and remain current on changes to the federal and state aid programs.
  • Must utilize conflict resolution skill set to pacify disgruntled students and parents, helping them to understand the situation and identify potential solutions to issues.
  • Maintain student confidentiality in accordance with FERPA regulations.
  • Ensures that students are receiving Exit Counseling information upon withdrawal, graduation or dropping below half time.
  • Monitors TEACH grant eligibility;
    checks GPA after each semester, ensure required documents are complete, send TEACH Exit information, etc.
  • On an occasional basis, travel to an off-campus meeting site to attend institutional workshops;
  • Maintain work area in a neat and orderly fashion
  • Assist the management and other office staff in special project assignments;
  • Participates incommittees under the direction of the Manager of Financial Aid counselors to review Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) appeals, Professional Judgment requests, and Howard University Scholarship appeals, as needed.
  • May be required to work evenings and weekends
  • Other duties as assigned by the financial aid director/associate director and/or Manager of Financial Aid Counselors.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Must have a thorough knowledge of available types of financial aid, scholarships and general student eligibility criteria.
  • Familiar with financial documents and a high competency of computer skills
  • Proficiency in technology and the systems used to determine student’s eligibility and originate a financial aid award. (These may include but not limited to: Banner, NSLDS, COD, CPS, ELM, MS, School Servicing Center, Campus Logic, Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Ability to interpret complex financial aid regulations and apply appropriately in different situations
  • Understanding personal income tax laws as they relate to federal financial aid
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the ability to use sound judgment for decision-making

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s Degree and at least two years of experience in financial aid (or a related area) or the equivalent combination of education and work experience combined.

description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

description:
Lead Talent Partner at Synamedia - We are Hiring! | Master's in European Studies and International Relations

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

Job description

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Local de Atuação: Miguel Pereira, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar o acompanhamento jurídico e contratual da concessão, incluindo o diagnóstico da realidade operacional frente às condições previstas no edital e contrato, a análise de passivos adquiridos e a gestão de eventuais contingências (concorrência/licitação), identificando divergências e propondo soluções;
  • Prestar assessoria jurídica às áreas internas em matérias contratuais e regulatórias, articulando-se com escritórios externos e demais gestores;
  • Atuar ativamente em reuniões com clientes internos e externos, órgãos públicos e agências reguladoras, oferecendo suporte jurídico e orientação legal para assegurar a conformidade das práticas operacionais com o Contrato de Concessão e a legislação vigente;
  • Atuar na área consultiva, prestando suporte jurídico estratégico às áreas internas com foco na interpretação e aplicação do Contrato de Concessão;
  • Apoiar e acompanhar pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro, elaborando peças jurídicas e revisando peças técnicas de suporte à defesa dos interesses da Concessionária;
  • Atuação na Revisão Ordinária do Contrato de Concessão;
  • Elaborar respostas a ofícios e manifestações da Agência Reguladoras, do Poder Concedente e demais stakeholders institucionais;
  • Gerir, administrar e prestar contas da documentação legal e regulatória da concessão, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais perante as Agências Reguladoras, o Poder Concedente e outros órgãos de controle;
  • Monitorar metase obrigações contratuais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e indicadores previstos no contrato e em normativos regulatórios;
  • Acompanhar novos regulamentos, legislações e interpretações normativas, atualizando procedimentos internos e promovendo o alinhamento institucional às diretrizes da AGENERSA, ANA e demais entidades setoriais (como a ABCON-RJ);
  • Prestar suporteem auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a adequada organização, arquivamento e rastreabilidade da documentação jurídica e contratual.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito,
  • Inscrição ativa na OAB;
  • Domínio no pacote Office, em especial no Power Point;
  • Experiência comdireito administrativo e regulatório;

  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário de Inglês.

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

title: Analista De Contratos Sênior
description:
Analista de Contratos Sênior

Join to apply for the Analista de Contratos Sênior role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile).
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Day‑off de aniversário.
  • TotalPass.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU)
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas semelhantes de gestão de compras e contratos
  • Excel avançado
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão
Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Benefícios
  • Plano de saúde de qualidade
  • Previdência privada
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile)
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)

description:
Já se imaginou fazendo parte da maior empresa de beleza do mundo?

AL'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”;
é agora a líder mundialda indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza;
onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

Como Gerente de Marketing Digital seu papel será desenvolver, direcionar e implementar a estratégia macro de advocacy, orientando as marcas da divisão para que cada uma desdobre suas ações de forma alinhada e consistente. Você será referência no entendimento do ecossistema digital, comunicação e influência, garantindo que as marcas utilizem o potencial dos influenciadores para fortalecer posicionamento, gerar conversas relevantes e impulsionar resultados de negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Estratégia de Marketing de Influência: Construir e liderar a estratégia de marketing de influência para toda a Divisão de Grande Público, definindo diretrizes macro e suportando as marcas no desdobramento tático, com foco em comunicação e construção de marca.
  • Ecossistema Digital: atuar com visão multifocal sobre o ecossistema digital e o papel dos influenciadores na construção de marca, geração de awareness e advocacy, conectando estratégias de social, comunicação e influência.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders: Ser ponte entre áreas internas, marcas e parceiros externos, garantindo sinergia, alinhamento estratégico e execução eficiente das iniciativas.
  • Análise de Dados e Resultados: Ser data driven, monitorando KPIs de campanhas de influência, gerando insights analíticos e propondo otimizações para maximizar impacto e mensuração de resultados, inclusive como campanhas de influência contribuem para vendas e construção de marca.
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Desenvolver e defender argumentos sólidos sobre o papel do marketing digital e de influência, guiando as decisões e garantindo que a comunicação da divisão esteja sempre inovadora, relevante e alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Gestão e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar um time de pessoas, promovendo visão de longo prazo, desenvolvimento de talentos e estruturação de processos para elevar a performance e a qualidade das entregas.
Conhecimentos Necessários
  • Experiência sólida em comunicação, influência digital e construção de marca.
  • Vivência em estratégias de marketing de influência e social, com domínio sobre como influenciadores contribuem para o fortalecimento de marca e geração de conversas.
  • Perfil generalista, com visão estratégica e capacidade de orientação de múltiplas marcas em ambientes complexos.
  • Habilidade para atuar em ecossistemas digitais, com olhar analítico e multifocal.
  • Experiência em liderança de pessoas, desenvolvimento de times e estruturação de frameworks/processos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, orientado a dados e geração de insights.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e PowerPoint.
O que você vai encontrar
  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours.

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month. 25 hrs a week. Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte
  • Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About youExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil's largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership
Important Notes Below

Always aiming for the safety and well-being of our employees, the COVID-19 vaccination certificate is an essential item for all employees, being present in the list of admission documents.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, nationality, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

  • Experiência com a metodologia ágil Scrum em um ambiente de equipe distribuída.

  • Conhecimento em Ruby on Rails é um diferencial.


Formação e Experiência:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência demonstrada no desenvolvimento end-to-end de software, incluindo propriedade operacional .

title: Geophysicist
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Geophysicist at Katalyst Data Management supports geophysical data interpretation and analysis activities, working under the guidance of senior technical staff to deliver high-quality consultancy services. This role requires foundational knowledge of seismic interpretation, geological principles, and geophysical data processing techniques. The Geophysicist will assist in structural and stratigraphic interpretation projects, contribute to prospect evaluation, and support client deliverables while developing expertise in industry-standard geophysical software and workflows.

Tasks:

  • Assist in subsurface data management including seismic (Raw data, Pre-Stack and Post-Stack), well files (VSPs and well logs) and derivative products. 
  • Conduct quality control on seismic data and interpretation products.
  • Assist in the preparation of technical reports, presentations, and client deliverables.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and contribute technical insights.
  • Maintain subsurface databases and ensure data integrity. 
  • Support senior staff in prospect evaluation and risk assessment activities.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Highly organized, capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
  • Proficient in geospatial and seismic interpretation tools, including ArcGIS, QGIS, Petrel, and DSG.
  • Experienced with industry-standard data formats, such as SEGY for seismic data and LAS/DLIS for well logs.
  • Solid foundation in geophysical principles, including seismic wave propagation and rock physics.
  • Thorough understanding of oil and gas operations, including bid rounds, ANP documentation, production reporting, and farm-in/farm-out processes.
  • Familiar with interpretation datasets, such as formation tops, horizons, and structural grids.
  • Skilled in developing presentations and analytical reports to support technical and strategic initiatives.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn, with a commitment to continuous improvement and emerging technologies.

Supervisory Responsibilities: 

This role will be responsible for providing guidance to multiple sectors in the company, the support will always be related to the understanding of the sub-surface data.

Work Environment: 

This job operates in a professional office environment, with a hybrid regime.  This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and phones.

Physical Demands:

The role is primarily sedentary and requires the ability to sit for extended periods. It also involves prolonged computer use, which may include typing, viewing screens, and interacting with digital systems for much of the workday.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: 

This is a full-time role, and as such, the Geophysicist is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional night and weekend hours are expected in support of our global operations.

Travel: 

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate.

Required Education and Experience 

  • Bachelor's degree in a geology or geophysicists 
  • Working proficiency in English, both oral and written.

Por meio de uma infraestrutura de ponta, desenvolvida em parceria com a Flowa Technologies, a Base visa ampliar o mercado de capitais do país, trazendo mais uma opção para que empresas e investidores façam seus negócios com transparência, agilidade e tecnologia. No seu dia a dia você irá

  • Criar indicadores e alertas de supervisão de mercado de bolsa;

O que você precisa:

  • Experiência na configuração de sistemas de supervisão de mercado, criação de indicadores e alertas automáticos para detecção de práticas irregulares e análise de padrões atípicos de negociação;
  • Vivência na investigação de operações atípicas, envolvendo indícios de manipulação de preços, criação de condições artificiais, insider trading, wash trades, spoofing, layering e money pass, com base em dados de mercado e registros de negociação;

  • Certificações profissionais como CPA-20, CEA, CNPI, CGA, ou certificações internacionais relacionadas a mercado de capitais.
  • MBA ou pós-graduação em Mercado Financeiro, Risco, Compliance, Regulação ou Direito do Mercado de Capitais;
  • Conhecimento de programação e data analytics aplicados à detecção de padrões e automação de alertas de supervisão.

A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 


 
Como é ser um(a) Líder de Vendas - Inside Sales (Inbound/Outbound):
Sua missão será liderar um time de vendas consultivas, acompanhando de perto os indicadores, traçando planos de ação para o alcance do resultado esperado, focando no desenvolvimento dos seus liderados, fornecendo feedbacks constantes, construindo planos de desenvolvimento individual e de carreira e trazendo ações para reforçar a cultura de foco no(a) cliente dentro da companhia.
Principais responsabilidades:
  • Gerenciar entregas, indicadores, resultados operacionais e rotinas do time sob sua liderança;
  • Analisar indicadores e construir planos de ação;
  • Desenvolver o time através da construção de PDIs e planos de ação estruturados;
  • Compreender a fundo o mercado que estamos inseridos;
  • Contribuir com novos insights perante fluxos, processos e resultados;
  • Realizar projetos focado na melhoria de processos;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores;
  • Participar do processo de contratação de novos agentes;
  • Conduzir de reuniões de rotina com o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade do processo de venda do time.
O que esperamos de você:
  • Experiência prévia como liderança por no mínimo 6 meses e vontade genuína de liderar pessoas;
  • Graduação superior (sem exigência de curso específico);
  • Conhecimento em Excel para gerar relatórios e fazer análises complexas de indicadores;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e escuta ativa;
  • Habilidade para articulação de problemas com diferentes públicos;
  • Proatividade para aprender e melhorar continuamente.
Jornada de Trabalho:
  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Segunda a sexta e escala esporádica aos finais de semana.
Modelo e Local de trabalho:
  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes essenciais. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
